question.question: For a two-player Rival Agent turn, what happens to occupied-space cards, empty deck/Reshuffle, space costs/effects, recruitment, deployment and Harvest Spice bonus? What if a two-space card’s applicable option is occupied?

answer.answer: If indicated space is occupied, reveal another card until eligible. Reshuffle immediately if deck empty or Reshuffle appears; continue revealing. Ignore space costs, requirements, and effects; resolve card icons/instructions. Troop icons recruit, deploying on Combat spaces, otherwise garrison; every Combat visit automatically deploys up to two garrison troops (one if only one). Harvest Spice takes Maker space with most bonus, tie by total base-plus-bonus; if none has bonus, reveal another card. For a two-space card, use only condition-matching option; if occupied, draw again, never switch options.
answer.evidence: House Hagal Agent turns paragraphs specify all listed procedures.

question.question: In two-player Combat how does House Hagal get strength and handle rewards/control, including if it wins a space you control? Do human second-place ties pay the third reward even though ordinary third place is unavailable?

answer.answer: If Hagal has a Conflict troop, at start of Combat reveal Hagal cards until non-Reshuffle; add that card’s swords to 2 per deployed troop, then humans may play Combat Intrigue. Hagal occupies its rank but gets no reward. If it wins a space a human controls, remove that Control marker and Hagal does not replace it. Human tie for second earns third reward; ordinary third earns none.
answer.evidence: Combat strength procedure; Hagal receives no reward but occupies rank; control and tie rules.
